'''Orinar''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Celen]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], a small gas pipeline was constructed connecting Orinar to the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Chelpori]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
